train_test_split_method: GroupShuffleSplit, group=PSU, test_size=0.20, seed search over [42..91], first satisfying seed=42
note: Default 0.5 threshold used ONLY for baseline CV comparison metrics (ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are threshold-independent and are the primary comparison metrics). No threshold tuning, no calibration, no final-test-set evaluation performed at this stage.
preprocessing: Inside sklearn Pipeline per fold (SimpleImputer + StandardScaler for numeric, SimpleImputer + OneHotEncoder for categorical) - fit only on each fold's training portion, no leakage across folds.
